# Erling Braut Haaland
## “My aim is to inspire young people in the joys and benefits of sports.”
### A unique career
Erling Braut Haaland (23) was born in Leeds, England, but grew up in Bryne, Norway. Haaland’s sensational career started at his home club Bryne FK – where he demonstrated an unusual appetite and talent for scoring goals from an early age.
Erling then played two successful seasons for Molde FK, before moving to Austria and Red Bull Salzburg. He won the Austrian Bundesliga two times, and the Austrian Cup once. Scoring 8 goals in the Champions League, Haaland presented himself as a massive threat to any international team.
From December 2019, he played for Borussia Dortmund in the German Bundesliga, with 13 goals in the Champions League and a total of 86 goals in 89 games.

### Today
As of May 2022, Erling Haaland officially became a player for Manchester City under Pep Guardiola. With a staggering 52 goals in his first season for the Citizens, Haaland broke the record for most goals scored in all competitions by a Premier League club player.
With 36 goals in the Premier League, he also broke the record for most goals in a single Premier League season. In fact, he set so many records that we do not have the space to list them all here!
